output.one_line: Completes transfer of CAE Canada's 50% stake in HATSOFF Helicopter Training to HAL; HATSOFF becomes wholly owned.
output.so_what: Routine completion of the Oct-2026 deal. Consideration is not disclosed; the shares' face value (about Rs 38 cr) is about 0.1% of TTM revenue, so impact looks small.
